implementation.scope: Whole number and length unit with explicit/flattened/corrupt power suffix in text regions; plain units and overlapping PP formula proposals remain on existing paths.
implementation.acceptance: Exactly matching source number and unit, exactly one image-recognized msup with exponent 2 or 3, no extra tokens; explicit/observed digit power conflicts withheld.
implementation.speech_origin: UniMERNet image recognition → MathJax → native MathCAT; no invented exponent or replacement speech.

verification.manual_next_step: Import the same page as a NEW material in build10; inspect four cm² and four m² answers for correct number/unit/power and absence of extra semicolon/digit. Existing saved material is not reprocessed.

limitations: Build/install success does not establish recognition accuracy. No new unit inference or fixtures were executed.
The route depends on Vision range boxes and a recognizable source number/unit/suffix. Missed OCR patterns or PP overlap may prevent a supplemental crop.
Strict validation may withhold legitimate image output when source OCR digits/separators disagree; source and raw model output remain intact.
Actual MathCAT pronunciation of multi-letter units and numeric separators still requires the user-run check.
